title: DomainNoticeExtraction
description: Schema v1 for structured extraction of internet domain administration notices.

schema_version.description: Schema version number. Must be 1 for this version.

notice_id.description: Unique identifier for the notice, e.g. DN-001.

domain_name.description: The fully qualified domain name referenced in the notice.

registrar.description: The domain registrar issuing or referenced in the notice.

notice_date.description: Date the notice was issued in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.

action_required.description: Whether the recipient must take action.

deadline.description: Action deadline in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD, or null if none.

amount_due_usd.description: Fee or amount due in USD, or null if no payment required.
